messages:
allen_customer: Hey team, we saw a massive drop in embedding cache hit rate and a billing spike starting ~10:10 UTC. Hit% went from ~82% -> ~6% for our tenant (acme-app). Also seeing intermittent dim mismatch errors (expected 1024, got 768). Sample request id: req_20211102_ABC123. Any ideas?

jess_support: Sorry you're hitting that, @allen_customer. Can you paste a minimal request + the exact error you see? Also any recent client SDK changes?

allen_customer: Repro payload (sanitized):
```json
POST /v1/embeddings
{
  "model": "mpnet-embed",
  "input": ["foo bar"],
  "prefix": "acme:user:",
  "batch_size": 16
}
```
Error snippet from our logs:
```
embed-service: cached vector length 768 but consumer expected 1024 -> DimensionMismatchError: got=768 want=1024 (req=req_20211102_ABC123)
```
We rolled a client lib update yesterday that added `prefix` and `batch_size` hints. Not sure if that changed anything server-side.

priya_eng: Thanks — this is useful. Short summary of what I see after an initial look: our embedding cache keys historically included input hash + prefix, but (bug) did NOT include model_variant_id / quantization profile. If two different model backends (or model revisions) share the same public model alias `mpnet-embed`, a cached vector from one backend (768-dim) can be returned to a request routed to another backend (1024-dim). That explains both the hit spike (unexpected cross-tenant/variant hits) and the dim mismatch error.

priya_eng: Repro steps I used (internal):
1) generate embeddings with backend A (mpnet-v1, dim=768) for input "foo bar" with prefix `acme:user:` -> cached.
2) switch routing so alias `mpnet-embed` points to backend B (mpnet-v2, dim=1024).
3) request same input with same prefix -> cache lookup hits and returns 768 vector to a 1024 consumer -> DimensionMismatch.

priya_eng: Important details: cache key = sha256(prefix + input) currently. It does not include model_backend_id, quantize_profile, or tenant namespace metadata beyond the prefix string. If a tenant reuses a short prefix across multiple subprojects/variants (or if we swap model behind an alias), collisions happen.

allen_customer: Ah — we did change the model alias last night (mpnet-embed -> mpnet latest), and the SDK update standardized prefixes to `acme:user:` (we used to include service-specific suffixes). So that sounds like it would trigger this.

mike_sre: Immediate mitigation options:
- Invalidate the affected prefix namespace for `acme` (purge keys starting with `acme:user:`) -> will force fresh embeddings and stop dim mismatch/errors.
- Temporarily disable caching for your tenant via admin flag (we can flip it for you for the next 2 hours while we purge and patch).

mike_sre: Admin purge command (internal tooling example):
```
POST /internal/cache/purge
{ "namespace": "acme", "prefix": "acme:user:" }
```
I can run this on request.

jess_support: I'll coordinate the purge and flag flip. @billing-bot note: customer reported unexpected billing spike tied to cross-variant hits; please review credits while we remediate.

billing-bot: Logged billing review ticket BL-20211102-77. Will propose pro-rated credit for excess token/embedding units while we confirm root cause.

priya_eng: Long-term fix: we'll include model_backend_id + quant_profile + public_model_alias in the cache key canonicalization. Also will treat the `prefix` as tenant-provided namespace but still incorporate tenant_id from auth token to avoid silent cross-tenant collisions if two tenants accidentally choose identical prefixes. Plan: patch + canary today, full rollout tomorrow.

deploy-bot: canary rollout of cache-key canonicalization started at 21:06 UTC on 20211102 -> target 10% of nodes. Monitoring hit/miss rates.

jess_support: @allen_customer - we will: 1) purge your `acme:user:` namespace now, 2) temporarily disable caching for your tenant for 90 minutes, 3) monitor hit rates and errors, 4) schedule a follow-up so we can coordinate the patch rollout to avoid surprises. Sound ok?

allen_customer: Yes please do the purge and cache disable. Appreciate the quick triage. Please keep me posted. :pray:

priya_eng: Executed internal repro and verified purge would clear the wrong-dim artifacts. After purge we got consistent 1024 vectors and hit rate returned to expected levels (post-warmup). We'll post updates once the key-change patch is fully rolled out.

jess_support: Closing loop: created support ticket S-20211102-319 and internal incident INC-20211102-9. We'll update this thread when billing credit confirmed and when the cache-key patch fully rolled.

allen_customer: Thanks all :thumbsup:
